mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.5%, it signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the discount rate for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases the discount rate for equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.5), or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline below 1050 while industrial production (INDPRO) rises above 107.2, it signals a demand shock that reduces corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1050 and INDPRO > 107.2), or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0% and rising > 0.1pp in 3 months), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain an accommodative monetary policy, reducing the risk-free rate and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.0 and UNRATE rising > 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0 and rising > 0.1pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts are below 1060 thousand units, it signals weak residential demand, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1060, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 105.0 (index 2017=100), it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, reducing corporate earnings growth and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI (CPIAUCSL) rises above 238.0 while the federal funds rate remains below 0.2%, it signals a risk of inflationary pressure without monetary tightening, leading to increased equity volatility and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 238.0 and FEDFUNDS < 0.2), or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high residential investment demand regime (RSAFS > 448000), the strong housing market supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS > 448000, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
